format: new free-standing Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen restaurant (single unit, Franchise Agreement)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen franchised business, exclusive of real estate costs, is between $1,222,045 and $3,923,245 for a new free-standing facility, and between $504,545 and $1,968,245 for a new in-line facility. This includes $54,755 to $149,545 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.

fee.quote: Under the Franchise Agreement you must pay us a $50,000 franchise fee for a Popeyes Restaurant (“Initial Franchise Fee”) before opening the Franchised Restaurant.
fee.note: Veterans Development Incentive Program: fee reduced from $50,000 to $27,500 and royalty 2% for 6 months (first new restaurant, new franchisee). College and Airport Incentive Programs: $12,500 fee and 0% Advertising Contribution. Fee may be reduced for Alternative Venues. Fees actually paid in fiscal 2025 ranged from $0 to $50,000. MTRA deposit of $25,000 per committed restaurant is credited against the fee. Background check generally $210 (U.S.).

royalty.basis: gross sales (all revenue related to the Restaurant, less sales taxes)
royalty.quote: Royalty2 & 3 5% of Gross Sales (see Notes 2 and 3). Weekly on Gross Sales for the prior week. “Gross Sales” mean all revenue related to the Restaurant, less sales taxes.

adFund.quote: Advertising Contribution2 - 4 4.6% to 5.0% of Gross Sales (see Notes 2 - 4). Weekly on Gross Sales for the prior week. Restaurants participating in the Ad Fund Test Program will pay an Advertising Contribution of 5% starting April 1, 2025 (including all new franchisees) (see Note 4).
adFund.note: New franchisees must join the Ad Fund Test Program: 5.0% from April 1, 2025, may rise to 5.25% (as early as May 1, 2026) and 5.50% (as early as May 1, 2027) if 4-Wall EBITDA targets are met; reverts to 4.6% if the 5.0% test fails (unless a majority vote keeps 5%). Advertising Co-Op contributions currently 0.5% to 1.75% of Gross Sales on top, not exceeding 2% unless approved by unanimous member vote or bylaws (localPct = current high end).

otherRecurring.name: Consumer Ordering Technology Fee (Additional Ordering System / Additional Digital System)
otherRecurring.amount: $200 per Restaurant per month, plus 1% of Digital Sales, with an annual maximum per calendar year of $6,500 per Restaurant

otherRecurring.name: POP I.T. Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $1,980 per year, per Restaurant (for Restaurants with an Easy to Run Kitchen); billed monthly, in advance

otherRecurring.name: Sitewise
otherRecurring.amount: $4,545 annually (if you sign a Development Agreement, TRA or MTRA, or are a new franchisee in your first year)

otherRecurring.name: Guest Recovery Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Not to exceed $150 monthly; estimated average of $1,200 per Restaurant per year

otherRecurring.name: Food Safety Modernization Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $100 per restaurant per year

otherRecurring.name: Static Menu Board Kit
otherRecurring.amount: $200 - $300 per month (if no outdoor digital menu board installed)

rentToFranchisor: Only where Popeyes leases the premises to the franchisee (PL/PGL): minimum annual rent typically 10% of capitalized site acquisition and construction costs (or 125% of Popeyes' rent plus 10% of costs if Popeyes leases the property; for sold company restaurants the higher of that or 8.5% of trailing 12 months' Gross Sales), increasing 12% every 5 years, plus percentage rent typically 8.5% of monthly Gross Sales up to $133,333.33 and 10% on monthly Gross Sales above $133,333.33, in excess of the monthly minimum rent installment.

item19.note: U.S. restaurants (excluding U.S. territories) open throughout fiscal 2025; 61 franchised free-standing restaurants not in continuous operation excluded. Sales exclude refunds and sales taxes. EBITDA tables (from 2,435 of 2,818 franchised free-standing and in-line restaurants submitting P&Ls) deduct food & paper, labor and other costs (royalties, ad fund, rent included); EBITDA excludes owner's draw, depreciation, franchise fees and loan fees. 43.6% (980) of franchised free-standing restaurants met or exceeded the average. Sales only in Table I; costs shown in Tables IV-V.

special: If Popeyes or its affiliate leases the premises to you, rent is a minimum annual rent (typically 10% of capitalized site and construction costs, or 125% of Popeyes' rent plus 10% of costs) plus percentage rent typically 8.5% of monthly Gross Sales up to $133,333.33 and 10% above. Ad Fund Test Program can raise the Advertising Contribution from 5.0% to 5.25% and 5.50%, plus local Co-Op 0.5% to 1.75% (cap 2%). Royalties actually paid in 2025 ranged from 2% to 10%; non-traditional locations may be negotiated at 2% to 8%. If you use construction management vendors not on the Qualified Partners list, you must pay Popeyes $20,000 to $80,000 for review.
